source_semantic_controls: Confirmed positive improvements: current-year mowing/fertilizer/PSM filtering, positive full-area/removal evidence, explicit definition/contract missing lists, VF use, selective enrollment and the implemented content→modulation→cap→access subsequence.
The cross-year grazing counterexample includes an explicit end date proving current-year overlap. Missing mowing records alone are not treated as proof that no mowing occurred.

The official-area controls use a single equal-rate parcel, a known 0.02 ha difference and no extra penalty threshold. The overdeclaration control separately stipulates no statutory exception and isolates the missing 189 EUR net consequence from the correct 756 EUR gross and 378 EUR rate.

The LSE cap and modulation controls explicitly stipulate whole-field identity and other LSE eligibility. They test the foreign component or aggregate excess, not an invented legal allocation of overlap to measure 4.

The Alm/home-site distinction and 2028 takeover holiday/source-hierarchy question remain open. No universal below-home permission, blanket Alm exclusion or conclusive disputed-deadline oracle is invented.
Force-majeure workday controls stipulate the other necessary authority/causal facts. Timely filing alone is not approval, nor permission to excuse every obligation on a named parcel.

The full-reduction counter is assumed to mean legally relevant full annual sanctions, not arbitrary individual findings. Recovery scope and authority processes remain separate from annual payment arithmetic.
BM0 after performed but unlawful mowing is explicitly unresolved. No arbitrary content violation is automatically translated to 100% payment reduction.
